title: $2.077 Billion From 149 Shows
description:
Guess how much just one Eras Tour show sold in tickets?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: The Eras Tour: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Eras_Tour
- Wikipedia: Taylor Swift: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift

The Eras Tour (March 2023 to December 2024): 149 shows, 10.1 million attendance, $2.077 billion box office, the highest-grossing tour of all time. $2.077 billion / 149 = about $13.9 million per show (our math). In October 2023 it was reported that Swift had become a billionaire. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Guess how much just one Eras Tour show sold in tickets?
Just one night? About 13.9 million dollars, on average.
Then multiply by 149 shows. Almost two years on the road.
But the total? 2.077 billion dollars. The biggest tour ever.
Then, in October 2023, reports said she'd become a billionaire.
